name: SYNTHIA
description: Synthetic driving scenes for domain adaptation; SYNTHIA-RAND contains about 13k images. GTA5 is a related synthetic source whose separate licensing may pose a license risk; it is not included here and no data is redistributed. This record does not vendor or distribute dataset files.
citation: Ros, G., Sellart, L., Materzynska, J., Vazquez, D., & Lopez, A. M. (2016). The SYNTHIA Dataset: A Large Collection of Synthetic Images for Semantic Segmentation of Urban Scenes. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
